verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud deployment platform, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents Git-based deploys ("Connect your repo and ship with every push"), Docker support, and triggering deploys of existing services. Nothing shows uploading a local folder without a Git repo, or a deployment that stays private until you publish it; ephemeral previews and rollbacks are related but different features.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy a project by uploading a folder of files directly, with no Git repo required and the new deployment kept private until I choose to publish it
